216854.overview: Star-G3 is a commercial SEUCK game from Outlaw-Emix Software in 1990. It is an attempt and a fixed screen shooter for 1-2 players simultaneously.

216856.overview: A horizontally scrolling space shooter created by Petri Hassinen and published in Floppy Magazine 64 in 1989.

216864.overview: Star-G8 is a commercial SEUCK game from Outlaw-Emix Software in 1990. It is an attempt and a fixed screen shooter for 1-2 players simultaneously. Some would call it a sequel to Star-G3.

216867.overview:
A horizontally-scrolling shoot'em up for one player created by Michael Beier, Michael Martin Detert and Thomas Detert and published in both 64'er 1992/08, and in Game On 1992/07. Stoppt den Calippo Fresser (German: Stop the Calippo eater) is a mix of obstacle courses and simple puzzles. The game was paid by Langnese to advertise their Calippo freeze pops, introduced seven years earlier.

Somewhere in the Caribbean, on small Calippo-Island, crisis is imminent: The bad Calippo-eater is hoarding all the fruity fresh Calippos. As the chosen hero of the game, C.C.Cool, only you can stop him. There's no violence, but your energy is drained by obstacles (even clouds) and directly emptied by animals, replenished by the occasional floating Calippo and every 30000 points.

216868.overview:
A game designed by Pinov Vox (aka Giuseppe Vollaro) in the S.E.U.C.K. "Shoot'em up Construction Kit" (Sensible Software) for Commodore64. For the realization of this game in development they collaborate: creator Pinov Vox, asm code and music Richard Bayliss, Vg Vox for the music and the montages and for the graphic Picture "Fabs" (Fabio Marcon). The game project started in June 2019. However, I thank my friends for their collaboration.
 
Contributor, Pinov Vox brings to The New Dimension a full vertical scrolling space shoot 'em up called Super Vortex 2. An alien empire has attacked your base. In the verge to have your revenge, you set off in to deep space and do battle against many alien battle cruisers and alien forces. An new intergalactic war has taken place. It is now time for you to defend your own territory. This game can be played with 1 or 2 players, or with both players linked with a shared score and lives. It is time for you to cause a lot of devastation and destruction to the alien bases. Go on, make a big mess out of them!

216869.overview: A stand alone update created by Jim Jacob for the Super Sunday franchise published by Avalon Hill Game company. It is an American football management and strategy game.

216870.overview: A German language Mastermind style puzzle\board game, created by Michael Scholz and published in Game On 1994/06 which was released in the three-in-one combination (combi) release marked as Play Time 06/1994 and is noted on the box front.

216871.overview: the 1990's hit classic of 'Supremacy' by Probe Software and published via Virgin Mastertronic with stunning music by Jeroen Tel/David Whittaker(ST), has finally been released for the C64 by Excess as the Supremacy 30th Anniversary Edition!  As Supremacy Enhanced features not just a number of handy trainers, but this version of the game also features mouse support, an animated pixelated intro from the Amiga version, pixelated armor from the training screen thanks to the coding of Domingo, pixelated Starbase animation and space ships from the shop screen, as well as the weapons from the training screen thanks to Zsolt, improvements to the battle screen and much much more you'll just have to experience for yourselves.

216876.overview: Super Marioahner Sisters is a Giana Sisters MOD\ROM hack created by Atwood Studios in 2017.

216879.overview:
The Second World is a turn-based strategy game set in a science-fiction scenario. The play world is divided into 25 countries and four opponents (optionally all of them can be controlled by humans) want to become the leading force. This is either achieved by gaining control over 15 countries (either by buying them or with force), driving all competition out of the business or getting a certain amount of victory points with economic or belligerent achievements.

Gameplay focuses on economical management and can be seen as expanded Kaiser. During each round (which represents three months), the player can adjust the setting screws of the countries, e.g. by hiring agents (can be sent on special missions like assassinating an opponent), stock dealing, trading produced goods, setting the tax or starting a war. Especially important is constructing buildings like hospitals or plants. All those factors determine the statistics of the country, e.g. productivity , prosperity or the death rate. A killed ruler will be replaced by offspring if available. Gameplay is menu based with the exception of smaller action sequences.

An unofficial English version exists.

217198.overview: Avoid the baddies (stationary birds, meteorites, arrows, etc.) while flying through the night sky on your trusty winged horse. Developed by Luca Marras and released into the public domain in 1985.

217339.overview: Simon is a computerized conversion of Ralph Baer's classic musical puzzle game of the same name for the Commodore 64. This version was developed in BASIC by Cout Games and released into the public domain in January 2016.

217681.overview: The idea of this game is to jump from platform to platform and eat lettuce for points, of which the lettuce appears at random in the cave. The slug must also watch out for the falling droplets, which will make it lose a life. After the loss of the last life, the slug will explode, and you will carry the total number of points as your final score. You will have 10 minutes to survive and score as many points as possible. What is the chance of you achieving a hi score?

217907.overview:
The character that the player will have to control is Scout, a stray dog, who has to go through different mazes munching on the bones scattered in them and avoiding being captured by the dog catchers who are chasing him.
A level will end when all bones have been eaten.

The game has 32 levels to complete. It must be said, however, that the mazes are procedurally generated in a random way, therefore, with each new game, the player will find himself facing ever-changing levels. As the player advances through the levels, the speed of the chasers will increase more and more until he reaches the last level.

As a defense weapon, Scout has "barks" at his disposal, with which he can scare the dog catchers who will run away from our hero for a few seconds. As long as the enemies are scared, they are completely harmless. However, the barks cannot be used repeatedly, since about 3 seconds will have to pass before being able to bark again (at the top left of the screen there is a small bar that indicates the "charge" status of the bark).
For every certain number of bones devoured, a "magic" ball will come into play which, depending on the color, will perform different actions once collected. The red ball will activate the “x3” (the bones eaten later will be worth 30 points instead of 10). The blue ball will make all the enemies run away just like when using the bark. The purple ball will activate a letter inside the writing EXTRA placed at the top center of the screen; once the writing is complete, the player will earn a life. The cyan ball will make the dog catchers disappear for a few seconds, after which they will re-enter the entrance gate of the maze as if nothing had happened. Finally, there is a ball that changes color and that will give a different score depending on it (brown = 1000, green = 2000, yellow = 3000).

217933.overview:
This platform game for 1 or two players is part 2 of "Jonny and the Jimpys" and sequel to Bangers and Mash. Jonny while visiting his Grandma, finds the village under the spell of the evil witch Esmiralda. At present she is away from her castle having placed the 4 spellroom keys in dark towers near the castle.Jonny must first light the lamps to find the key and then return to the castle with it.
At first Esmiralda will leave the JIMPYS to catch him. Should Jonny open the the first door she will start on her way back to the castle, throwing thunderbolts at him if he dares to touch another key. At first her powers increase as she are weak but will
Can YOU help Jesse to home Tonny to open the doors and use the Book of Spells on HER before she returns and casts her evil spells on HIM?.
Jonny has one friend in the form of a green goblin who will send the JIMPYS on their way!

217957.overview:
A special (and updated) Christmas version of Soul Force. The Soultron star system has been at peace for millenniums, the echoes of warfare long faded, its people living in hope for a never-ending peaceful existence.

Yet some had looked out into the skies, wondering what lay beyond, and what dangers could descend upon their peaceful worlds. In secret they developed project Soul Force, an advanced space fighter designed to defend the Soultron system from an outside threat.

And from the darkness of deep space comes a terrible bio-mechanical fleet swarming into the Soultron star system, monstrous creations descending upon the peaceful planets, tearing into the ground for reasons unknown. Communication attempts remain unanswered, the invaders obliterating any ship brave enough to approach... and all that at Christmas time!!

We have chosen you to launch and pilot the new Soul Force space fighter against this terrifying threat and liberate our star system. Learn our enemy’s plans and put a stop to them for good. The fate of our star system lies in our hands. You are our last and only hope... to save Christmas!

217963.overview: A platformer created by Marcus Beyer & Fernando Munoz and published in Input 64 1987/07. "Last night I dreamed of spiders again!"-"ugh!"- Do you also feel that spiders are disgusting? At least they make you shiver, these hairy little multi-legged creatures. Not so "Spiders". You control a small spider -- using a joystick or keyboard -- through a confusing maze. On the way to the end point you have to collect 24 keys, because you need them to get a reward. Don't make this collection action too easy, though, because there are nasty traps built into the maze all along the way that the spider can't jump over. The only way to do this is to go back, if that is possible, because at a certain point it even ends up in a dead end. Then nothing works anymore. In some places there are small holes through which she can slip and get to a different position in the maze. If at any point nothing is running at all, just talk the spider into jumping. Some areas have built in overhangs or stairs for her to crawl up. Where these places are in the labyrinth is not revealed. By the way, Spider is a nice game with a cute little spider that I'm sure you'll all grow fond of soon.

218012.overview:
Despite looking like a Christmas game, Snowballs is in reality a holiday themed pinball game from Finland. It was developed by Toni Luode and published in Floppy Magazine 1987/6.

For some strange reason, however, the developer decided to go with a rendition of the Star Wars theme for the music.

218014.overview:
In this Christmas themed shooter, you play the role of Jolly old Saint Nick himself as he battles hordes of evil robot snowmen as they try to destroy Christmas. It's up to you to save Christmas and the world. Good luck.

Released in the following:

French magazine Micro V.O No.12 (November 1986)

Euro-wide magazine Your Computer 1986/01

Your Computer #4 (a Spanish compilation pack) (called Snowbot on the box)

The only main differences between the Spanish and English versions is the text on the title screen is in different languages, the gameplay screenshots for both regions are in English. However, the French version has French text on the top of the screen in the in-game screenshots.

218160.overview: A tetris game for one player, created by Payton Byrd and with music by Péter Nagy-Miklós that was released as part of the RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition 2013.

218161.overview: In this educational music program created by Carousel Software in 1985, a variety of endearing characters teach early music concepts. It is intended for users ages 4-8.

218162.overview: Assemble atoms into molecules in the reactor. Take on the role of a Reactor Engineer working for SpaceChem, the leading chemical synthesizer for frontier colonies. Construct elaborate factories to transform raw materials into valuable chemical products! Streamline your designs to meet production quotas and survive encounters with the sinister threats that plague SpaceChem.

218256.overview:
Shocker is a Breakout/Arkanoid clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Fernando Zanini and published in Software Club N°15, as well as  Il Meglio di Software Club.

An unofficial version/hack was released a year later but renamed to Shock Zone II.

218685.overview:
Snake is yet another of your typical garden variety Snake clones. This one is for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Vince Apps, and published as a type in game in the book "The Commodore 64 Program Book" in 1983.

Like the vast majority of BASIC language type ins, this is keyboard controlled only.

218687.overview: Snake is a  1996 solitaire variant for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Maurice Jones and published in Loadstar #141

219132.overview:
A maze game for the Commodore 64 where you try to collect as much treasure as possible, while the Monster of Dungeons tries to stop you! It's also hungry!
You leave a trail while moving, which the Monster follows, but there are ways to make it go astray...
Superchase Remix is called like that because I remixed three different versions of the same game that got published in Compute! magazines and books in the early '80s (the original Vic-20 version was published on October 1982, so exactly 40 years ago).

219162.overview: An unreleased preview/playable demo developed by Cyntech Systems. The game was never officially finished. Go around the mazes to reach the level exit, but be careful, as there are obstacles. Touch one of the obstacles, and you have to start the maze all over again.

219200.overview:
This new version provides an overhaul of the visuals, introducing some fancy new environment art and a new redesign for its central protagonist Sabreman. As well as this, it also features a brand-new loading image and a new introductory credits scene featuring Sabreman tumbling through the canopy of the rainforest.

Like the original, in this remaster, the ACG amulet (a reference to Ultimate's formal name of Ashby Computers and Graphics), has been split into four pieces, which are located in different parts of a jungle, and you're the intrepid explorer sent to locate them.

219205.overview: A Halloween mini game released with the  All Hallows' Eve pumpkin demo at the C64 Demo Competition at Zoo 2022. In it you wield the Homelite XL-12 chainsaw that replaces the hand you had to cut off to avoid it turning you evil. You must use it to block the horde of oncoming evil pumkins. Hail to the King, baby!

219207.overview: Your quest is to destroy the invading army and save the kingdom. You will fight them honorably, one at a time in single combat. Learn the limits of the form and become the sword master.

219209.overview: Santa Claus is shocked, as someone has stolen his sleigh. The sleigh is full of presents, and these will be thrown out of the sleigh. Santa has to collect all the presents, as his happiness else will decrease down to zero and the game will end. Santa can catch the presents in the air or from the bottom. If they are on the bottom too long they will explode and happiness will decrease. Every present Santa collects gives 10 points.

219318.overview:
Our little teddy bear is a prize in a fairground side alley. As all fairground characters do, he comes alive after everyone has gone home ... 

Our hero is the security guard, employed to look after the fairground. He really cares about his teddy bear friend. Late at night, worn out by their antics the happy prizes all fall asleep.

Tonight however, when he checked on his little friend, security guard found that teddy was missing!! Teddy has gone sleepwalking and is in danger!!

Sleepwalker's safety depends on you being able to guide our hero to help sleepwalker get back to his bed!!

219319.overview: A single player action game by Eric Hilaire ( aka Majikeyric), with music by Vidar Bang. Released as a coordinated effort by MegaStyle and Protovision in 2018. Keep the little red bird flying. When you bounce in the walls the bird will change direction. Beware of the spikes that comes out from the wall.

219670.overview: An unofficial sequel to Commodore's own port of the classic arcade game of the same name. This was released on February 25, 2023.

219673.overview: Classic shoot-em-up action for the COMMODORE 64 with some unseen elements or features included that only those who possess the shaman's eye shall discover. An Arcade Shoot em up in which you must destroy waves of enemies for a high score. Game is a ROM hack of The 1982 Galaga game by Henrik Wening originally published in Courbois Software #6414 with just modifications to colors, title and addition of some really nice boot screens and intro graphics.

219676.overview:
In this Boulder Dash style game you're "Willy Beisser", a stone-age guy digging for cabbages in caves to provide yummy meal for his family. And that's it. Once you collected all cabbages in one cave, it's "solved" and you can tackle the next one. This is a port of an old AmigaBASIC game from 1986 by Zirias.  
 
Though the game "borrows" from Boulder Dash. But be aware, it works VERY differently. Some key differences, there are no monsters, rocks never "explode" (but may roll off), you CAN'T run away from rocks, but you CAN move diagonally (which is sometimes necessary to solve a level). All in all, it's about planning ahead and doing the correct steps. A mini map is available on the bottom right to help navigate.

219677.overview:
A lot of you will remember seeing this game on the ZZap64 magazine covertape one issue… but it wasn’t specially designed for the magazine….

It was originally programmed for Ocean, but Ocean didn’t like the game as they felt it wouldn’t sell and decided not to release it, and so Denton Designs were stuck with a complete game. The main problem really was that the vector graphics were a bit slow.

After Denton Designs looked for another publisher, without success, they sold the game to Zzap64 for them to spread on their covertape at a small cost to cover their losses.

The game itself features some slowish vector graphics, and involves you in a race within a series of tunnels against other crafts (All looking a bit Starfox style)… A nice addictive game, if only held back by the slowness. The game’s graphics were created by the same guy who was working on Megatree, Stuart Fotheringham with fantastic music by Fred Grey.

219678.overview: Help Santa to create a path to walk through the maze and find a key that opens the exit.

219705.overview:
TND Games is very proud to present to you an entry for the Snake Fun Compo on CSDB. Snake VS Bomb is a fun for five minutes hi score challenge that features the following:

    8 Levels of increasing speed 
    Addictive gameplay
    Loading bitmap
    Front end presentation
    Hi score table
    Arcade style sound effects and cool music
    Plus much more.
    PAL/NTSC compatible
    Compatible with theC64 mini, theC64, full size and theVIC20

This is a fun hi score attack challenge, featuring 8 levels of madcap mayhem. You are a snake, which is traveling through a very long tunnel. During your travels you encounter fruit and bombs, which are placed at random inside the tunnel. The snake can eat the fruit if the fruit reaches its head for points. However, the bombs must be avoided. If any part of the snake collides into a bomb (or vice-versa), the bomb will explode along with the snake. The game will then be over.

219728.overview: An old school downhill slalom skiing game with a Christmas theme, in which you play Santa Claus trying to save Christmas. The game was developed and released by !NG73 on December 11, 2022.

219744.overview:
Four years after saving her creator and escaping base Omega, Synthia learns of a group of pre-war survivors in stasis, held hostage by an insane military artificial intelligence. Synthia must infiltrate the GOD complex, overcome the ID and free the sleeping survivors. Only then human kind and indeed cyber kind have a realistic chance in prospering survival. If Synthia fails, we are all doomed ... If Synthia succeeds, you will be awarded a pass code for the finale (Which must be loaded in separately).

Guide Synthia around the mines picking up various objects and solving clues on the way. Each object you pick up can help you progress further into the game. Locate a flashing ? and click fire on the ? symbol to see whether or not your clue has been solved.

219809.overview:
Humans have advanced into the age of the 4th industrial revolution. AI and mechanical machinery once beleived to be a work of fiction, are now possible! This future tech is capable of acting, thinking and communicating just like humans! The advancement have come at a cost however and efforts are being made to impair this next level AI. 
In the year 2172, a rogue piece of malware from an unknown vigilante has started to infect next level machinery and turn them against mankind and the uninfected.
The government has entrusted you as the commander of their dwindling army. You must use your wits and will to destroy the enemy and take down their banner. Be warned, there's no safe options in this game, so best go in guns blazing!
Shallow Domains is a turn based strategy game for the C64 that is played against an AI on a hexagonal map.

219812.overview:
Not to be confused with the game that was published in Input 64  1987/07 of the same name, Spider by Johannes Braun is a homebrew conversion of the popular solitaire card game of the same name.

The game was released in 2005.

219867.overview:
Follow Halley's comet...and much more with Star Seeker. 
• Construct and print out star and solar system maps from any point on Earth at any time or date over several centuries
• Call up a mass of information on a particular star, constellation, or planet
• Follow the relative positions of the stars and orbital motions of the planets in the Solar System
• Plot the path of Halley's Comet as it crosses our skies this winter on its
once-in-a-lifetime visit Predict the orbit, phase, and age of the Moon 
 
Published in association with the London Planetarium, Star Seeker and its companion program, Solar System, gives you all this and much, much more. The comprehensive manual provides background information, latitude and longitude tables, extensive ideas for using the programs, and complete lists of the stars and constellations featured.

219877.overview: Albert is a 27 year old sewing machine attendant from North Yorkshire. He wins a national contest. The prize "A Night With Zelda The First Lady of Soho". What a way to go, but before you get to Zelda's bedroom, you must first encounter the dark and luring parts of Soho. If you go wrong the pimps, perverts and police will get you. Good luck Albert... you'll need it.

220005.overview: An arcade style catch-it game written for the Reset64 4K competition 2020 By Nick Sherman.

220103.overview:
A VIC 20 Sub Chase remake for the Commodore 64 by Karsten Senkel. Features: 8 different enemies, 3 game modes for 1 or 2 player simultaneously,
weapon upgrades, balanced difficulty curve and a highscore table. Game starts with 3 lives for each player. An extra life is provided every 10000 points.
In cooperative mode there is a common life counter for both players, so a gained extra life can revive a previously eliminated player. At the beginning, every ship is equipped with 2 depth charge launchers and a shockwave bomb. By wrecking special targets, 3 additional launchers can be obtained, so that a maximum of 5 depth charges per player can be active at one time. If all possible launchers are in place, the destruction of more special targets will restore missing shockwave bombs. If these bombs are already present, shockwaves are triggered. Losing a life decreases the number of additional
launchers. A new shockwave bomb is also provided with every new level.

220110.overview: 1 Player Arcade Style Underwater Shoot 'em Up by TheReaperUK and with with Hi-Score Saving. Made with help from the Shoot 'Em' Up Construction Kit by Sensible Software and Sideway Version by Jon Wells, Modified SEUCK framework Code by Me, Original Framework Code by Richard Bayliss of TND, Music By Andrew Fisher (Merman).

220115.overview: Welcome to SUB-BATTLE 64, Move left-right and shoot the other Subs and Boats, Hi-Score Game no ending, You move Slow and you shoot 1 slow bullet at a time, Just like it was in the early 80's.

220118.overview:
One of the very many ports of the classic mainframe Star Trek strategy game, This one created by Richard Franklin and published in several places, including Commodore Computing International v03-05 (Nov 1984)  plus v03-06 (Dec 1984) plus v03-07 (Jan 1985) and also in the book "CBM 64 Programs - Volume 1". 
 
The adventure game listed on the next few pages must be considered the ultimate experience for all you 'Trekkies' or 'Trekkers' out there. The horrific news brought to all manner of living beings in the known galaxy by the interstellar video news system, has set men's
(and other things'!) minds in turmoil. The Klingons have reneged on the peace treaty and are even now conducting raids upon the Federation's outlying bases. The Federation, in the face of the despicable behaviour of the Klingon Emperor, has had no alternative but to go to WAR! Captain James T. Kirk has been conspicuous only by his absence in this debacle and you!, yes, you the player have been chosen to lead the defense, captaining the Star Ship Enterprise, aided by the faithful retainer and trusty, half human, pointy eared First Officer Spock. After a familiarization sortie, you progressively take on more and more difficult tasks until almost unaided you are defending the Federation against the evil might of the Klingons.

220135.overview: Super Nova is a home-brew space shooter game for the Commodore 64. It loosely pays homage to the old Atari classics Starmaster and Star Raiders. Your star system is attacked by six enemy battlestars that try to reach and destroy the sun. Your mission is to stop them! The status display shows either your enemy the condition of the sun. When it turns from yellow to red, then the nova is not far. Press M to open the map. This only possible if no enemy is in range. You can only fly to one of the next sectors to your current position.

239070.overview:
Schwert und Magie I is a German text adventure that incorporates elements of a fantasy single-player role-playing game in which the player embodies a 1st degree hero (or heroine) who has to solve a specific task by choosing between given alternatives. Your character is assigned certain primary attributes that are randomly determined at the beginning, for which you have to take tests as you progresses. The primary attributes are assigned among four choices: Intelligenz (Intelligence) (In), Charme (Charm) (Ch), Stärke (Strength) (St) and Geschicklichkeit (Dexterity) (Ge). The attributes that have an effect in combat are: Vitalität (Vitality) (Vit), Tapferkeit (Bravery) (Ta), Angriff (Attack) (An) and Verteidigung (Defense) (Ve).

Folge Nr. 1: Das geheimnisvolle Kraut - You wander, with both your wallet and stomach empty, aimlessly through the narrow streets of the city of Seghem in the province of Elluria which you reached this afternoon, asking here and there for something to do. A master craftsman, who informs you with feigned regret that he has no vacancy at the moment, says goodbye. However, he has heard that the court magician is looking for someone for a difficult task. So you decide to go up to the castle.

There you meet a pretty young woman with long black hair. Her name is Ijale and she is the daughter of His Majesty King Kasimirs. She asks you to find a specific medicinal herb that is difficult to obtain. Otherwise her father might die. Then her fiancé, the court wizard Thyron, a tall man in his thirties, clad in a dark cloak embroidered with magical symbols tells you that there is only one remedy for this Purple Fever disease: a tea made from a rare medicinal plant called Sanarie (sanus = Latin healthy; author's note). Unfortunately, he doesn't have this herb in stock. The only place where it can still be found is in a large forest a day's journey from the castle. You're supposed to get one of those plants from there.

After he warns you about a witch that lives in the forest, he also gives you a left-handed glove that prevents dirt from your hands to affect the healing power of the plant and an old textbook with the page that shows a Sanarie, describes its development and its use against Purple Fever and other diseases. The next morning you leave early. In the evening you can already see the forest where you decide to spend the night at the edge of the forest.

241875.overview:
A new C64 game which is using their in development fighting engine known as RetroFighter, a versus fighting engine with new features implemented such as a new UI and colour selection for each player, intro sequences before the battle commences for each player, flaming hits and projectiles, special moves, and different battle arenas. It features guard breakers and reversal moves, stage selection in versus mode and complete character storylines with intermission and even ending animations! 
 
Features fighting by Ryu, Ken, Chun-Li, Guile, Felicia, Zangief, Vega, Gouki, Ryo Sakazaki, Terry Bogard, Mai Shiranui, Andy Bogard, Leona Heidern, Wolfgang Krauser, Orochi Iori and Geese Howard.

242457.overview: Our friendly country has been invaded! It's up to you to pilot our latest drone and strike back at our enemy using both bombs and AA missiles. Cats need aid, so on bonus stages drop aid packages for them for bonus points.

330138.overview:
Space Station 23 has been hit by an asteroid and it's partly destroyed.
The space station is also invaded by a nasty species of aliens.
Joe Phoenix is back from the jungle and is now sent to the rescue. His mission is to collect resources to restore the full power of the space station and evict and kill all the aliens.

405975.overview:
Superbrain is a high-tech innovation of the computer-age. A program which tests the deductive powers of the mind, and stretches them to the limit. In Superbrain, the player confronts the ultimate opponent-the computer itself, a highly evolved and intricate thinking machine, which considers its options and makes its move with alarming speed and accuracy. But the human spirit is sometimes as effective a weapon as the cold micro-chip strategy of the Superbrain. Outwit the system...if you can. Superbrain a program of extreme intelligence.
 
After the title appears, press any key to begin. You will receive instructions. Press another key to receive the remaining instructions, then another key to begin the game. The object of the game is to guess the color and order of 5 colored squares. The computer chooses the 5 squares. At the top of the screen is a gray box with 5 question marks. These represent the 5 squares. Under this box are 10 pairs of gray boxes. You have 10 chances to guess the order and color of the squares. The right-hand column displays the squares as you guess them. The left-hand column will give you clues as to the accuracy of your guesses. In order to guess the color of the squares the following keys must be pressed:
1) BLACK 2) WHITE
3) RED
4) CYAN 5) PURPLE
6) GREEN 7) BLUE
8) YELLOW
If you guess the right color of a square but in the wrong place, the clue box will display a white square. If you guess the right colored square in the right place, the clue box will display a black square. 

In order to change any squares you have guessed, press the F7 key to move the cursor backward, and the F1 key to move forward. After you have made your guess, press the RETURN button. If you guess all 5 squares correctly you win the game. You have 10 chances to guess the squares in proper order. You may quit at any time by pressing the F4 key.

411282.overview:
A word quiz for children 6 to 9 years old created by David Winogrond and published by ALA Software in 1984. A program for youngsters must be simple and yet exciting to them, maintaining their interest and stimulating them to explore new concepts and master old ones.

SCHOOL TECH WORD SEARCH is just such a program. It presents the user with a variety of grammatical structures and problems, and gives them an opportunity to learn, by trial and error, the basic precepts of vocabulary, while furthering an awareness and ease with the computer. School Tech Word Search-a responsible educational system developed as an aid to in-class teaching, and at-home learning.

The child is shown a sentence with a word missing. Five choices are shown. Four are incorrect for spelling, grammar or context reasons. The child types in his/her choice. The next display shows if the answer was right. If wrong, the right answer is shown. The child can quit at any point in the quiz. A scoreboard is then displayed,
showing: words attempted, words right, words wrong, and the percentage right. The child is given the choice of repeating the quiz, or quitting.

417520.overview: A two-player only Tron\Light Cycle style game created by Jens Abraham and published in Input 64 1985/12.

417522.overview: Squish: Legend of the Lost Aliens is a 1-2 player co-operative shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Robin Evans using SEUCK (Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit) and released into the public domain in 2001.

417527.overview:
The introduction of Inter-City 125 High Speed Trains in the mid and late 1970s brought new standards of passenger travel, and radical changes in methods of railway operation. Fixed formation sets are diagrammed for intense utilization and rapid turnrounds by day and depot attention by night. Sets clocking up typically 800-100 miles of running in the course of a day require a nightly 'environmental' service supplemented by a comprehensive 'A' examination every other night. Major examinations are undertaken at progressively longer intervals, culminating in a complete works overhaul every few years. To service HST's depots were designed on a flow line system, and in this simulation you are the mid-week (Monday to Thursday) Night Production Manager at Bounds Green depot some five miles north of Kings Cross. 
 
 You direct and oversee servicing and maintenance of HST's arriving at Bounds Green each night, ensuring that where possible mechanically sound sets are provided for the following day's workings. Your screen display shows the progress of HST's through the flow line system. Time is updated in 20 minute increments by pressing the RETURN key rather than inputing a set number. On each hour the supervisor provides updates, if HST work is outstanding you will be given the opportunity of diverting labour from the heavy repair shop to aid service and maintenance roads. Two men may be directed to one or more of the roads. Enter the required codes in response to the 'men' prompt, a direct pressing of the RETURN key will result in a result to normal working. Any such redeployment will obviously disrupt the scheduled workload and in practical terms this may delay a spare power car becoming available later.

Each shift begins with a TOPS listing giving the condition and expected arrival times of incoming sets. Having been informed of the staffing situation try to formulate a strategy for dealing with the night's work. From 2040 hrs onwards, coaching stock undergoing daytime servicing will vacate the depot, and HST's will begin to arrive at Ferme Park. As sets become available they must be directed through the washing facility by specifying the 'W' command, if the washer is free and no more than one set is waiting at Bowes Park Waiting sets are directed into a service or maintenance road in the shed by entering a road code (S1-S4, M1 or M2) ensuring the selected road is free. Sets requiring remedial attention (denoted by /R on the end of their service code) should, if possible, be dealt with in maintenance roads (M1,M2) with any spare capacity in the M roads being sued for A examinations (AEX) rather than environmental (ENV) servicing. If remedial (AE/R or EN/R) looks like taking too long you have the options of swapping to a spare, if available (type PS), or aborting the work (type PA) sending the set out with a single working power car as a last resort measure.

417528.overview: Jump in the fast lane in some of Scotland's most scenic railways. Control the speed and the signals and manage all the freight and passengers to make the most money, have the least issues and meet the schedules.

417533.overview:
Scotti is is a single-screen platform game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Rainer Disser and published in Computronic 1985/11-12. What a fright Scotti's birthday evening he notices his house being haunted by ghosts. This is an incomprehensible situation for our little hero. But; Scotti acts quickly: he gathers whatever household effects he can find, hops down corridors, and rides the elevator to freedom.  
 
It is therefore necessary to smuggle Scotti out of the house undamaged using the joystick. Time is against him. So hurry up and collect as much as you can. Don't forget the washing machine either! You can use the joystick to move "your" Scotti: in addition to walking directions, Scotti can perform a small jump (fire button) and a large jump (fire button and forwards). Once in the elevator, he can either go up or down The game has six different images with high-resolution graphics. The remaining time is displayed at the top of the screen. Bonus points are awarded for unused time. A total of five Scottis are available to the inclined player to make the game successful. And now let's get started: SCOTTI is already waiting for you!

417560.overview: An educational, one player math game featuring the lovable Snoopy, who will help you learn math. It was created by Creative Computing & Albert Lee and released in 1982 in the Canadian exclusive Commodore 64 Program Pack and later in CBM Public Domain - Games III.

417747.overview:
You have to clear up the board by finding pairs of Mahjong tiles that can be connected by a line, with no more than 2 bends and which does not pass through any other tiles on the board.

The game has 3 difficulty levels, 2 different game modes (one playing against the clock, and one relaxing mode, just letting you solve the boards with unlimited time and help). It has unlimited levels (well, counter wraps at 9999…) and a high score saver. You can control the game with joystick or keyboard.

417750.overview:
Your task is to guide your snake safely along a road across a Canyon. You can only move the snake up or down. While travelling along the long straight road, admiring the scenery. During your very long journey, you will encounter scrumptious fruit that has been dropped on the road. However, there is also bad news. Bombs are also dropped on the road. 

At the top of the screen, you will see a green snake. Each part of the snake in the status panel will turn from green to gold. This indicates how far you have travelled. After the tongue of the snake is yellow and you travel a little further distance. You will move onto the next level, where more fruit and bombs will appear on the road, giving your snake less space to dodge those deadly bombs.

Can your snake reach safely to the other side of the canyon, or there be an explosive end for your snake? There's only one way to find out ... Play the game!

417989.overview: A maze collect em up developed by Cleveland Blakemore and published in Ahoy! 1988/06 (Issue #54), but was also released in Loadstar #245.

417990.overview: A text based game by Mary Jean Winter where you sail around Africa trying to find a sea passage to India.  It's like The Oregon Trail, but with pirates and cannibals. Published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1984/03 (Issue #09), and later in Best of COMPUTE! & Gazette / a.k.a. "Reis Naar India" in a Dutch release.

417995.overview:
Sturgrat: Mission I is a miscellaneous shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Robert Germino and published in Loadstar # 054 in 1988. Use your joystick and your tactical skills to pilot the Sturgrat, the most sophisticated starship in existence. Your planet is depending on you! It is with a certain amount of pride and trepidation that you take the helm of the Sturgrat -- a Sturgrat pilot must move quickly and juggle several factors at once. One of the main factors is fuel. The transport vessels, which fly side-by-side behind you need occasional replenishment from the asteroids that inhabit the galaxy. The shields will protect them from damage should they collide with an asteroid, but the shields may become damaged. The indicators of the status of the shields are two vertical bars on either side of the Fuel and Warp gauges. If either of these two indicators becomes low, you must stop your forward movement and scan for local energy by pressing the F1 key.  
 
If you run low on fuel, which is shown in the Fuel gauge, you must have the transport vessels collide with the fuel-rich asteroids. Your shields will become damaged but often the increase in fuel is worth it. All of your requirements are inter-related and you must keep track of all of them. Your ship, alongside its primary armament are equipped with 8 neutron cylinders which will destroy any attacker in sight. They are indicated  by vertical bars near the top of the screen. Press F5 to invoke them. If you have sufficient fuel you can convert fuel into more cylinders by pressing F7.

418000.overview: Squash-Brick is a French language keyboard controlled Breakout clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Michel Colette and published in Hebdogiciel N°128 (28.03.1986).

418032.overview: Sulphur Eye is a new 3D-adventure game for the Commodore C64 computer. The game, is developed by Tomas Zanvit, and is in the Slovakian language. An English version is also available.

418065.overview:
Screwy Screws is a public domain puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published by Pure Productions in 1999.

The aim of the game is to rotate all the screws on the screen until they match.

418175.overview: Super Toboggan Challenge is a crosss between a racing game and a collec em uip. You are riding a toboggan down a ski slope and most collect various items along with way, while avoiding other obstacles such as trees and roadblocks.

418926.overview: This platform shooter created by dotmos and submitted to the Retro Platform Jam#6 is available for a number of retro computers and consoles. Updates since the game jam on itch.io have fixed and improved the game as well as added a number of new levels.

419233.overview: Snapman is a Pac-Man clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed by David Rees and published in Your Computer 1984/04, a magazine that was sold in both Europe and the US/Canada.

419241.overview: Six Games in a Crane aka Crane Driver is a collection of six educational mini games for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published by Alexander Leslie Software in 1984.

419242.overview: Space Lander for the Commodore 64 is a science fiction themed math game. It was developed and published by Alexander Leslie Software in 1984.

421149.overview: Solitaire is a clone of Microsoft Solitaire (early versions) for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Friedrich Philipp of WebFritzi, and released into the public domain in 2022.

421874.overview: The Starchild is a text adventure for the Commodore 64. It is a sequel to a game called The Ark of Exodus. The game was developed by Grant Thomson and released in 1988. The publisher is not known.

421947.overview:
Snake 64 (Slippery Sid on the UK cassette tape, and Slange 64 in Norway) is a snake game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Wayne Turner and published in the following:

-   64 Tape Computing No. 03 (1984/08-09) / a.k.a. "Slippery Sid" on tape
-   In Norway as Slange 64 in 64 Tape Computing Nr. 2

421966.overview:
Surround is 1-2 player Othello/Reversi game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Richard Drummond and published in the following:

-   Commodore Disk User 1990/03
-   Your Commodore 1990/11 (Tape #11)

422207.overview: Not to be confused with the game of the same name from Sir-Tech Software, this is an education math based (division) board/puzzle game) The game was developed by Scott, Foresman and Company and published by Thunder Mountain in

424337.overview: A German language ski jumping game by Christian Rduch  of Raddish-Soft published in the Compute mit 1987/02 magazine.

424339.overview:
One of two Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit games for the Commodore 64 with the same name.

This one was developed by Massoft and released into the public domain in 1992. This one has up to 2 players (co-op).

424345.overview:
One of two Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit games for the Commodore 64 with the same name.

This one was developed by Ermig Productions and released in the public domain in 1994. Unlike the game by Massoft, this one is 1 player only.

424354.overview: Shoot the Moon! is a miscellaneous card game for the C64. It was developed by William M. Shockley and published in Loadstar #061 in 1989.

425194.overview:
It's Christmas Eve. Santa has to deliver the gifts, but be careful, so you don't wake up the kids or pets!
Santa will fall from the chimney and your task is to find the Christmas tree somewhere in the house.
Every time you walk, enter a door, or move a piece of furniture, a sound is generated.
There are lying some slippers around the houses, which will make your movement silent for a while.
Don't let your sneak meter get full!

425241.overview: A selectable answers text adventure from Linus Åkesson, released at Gubbdata 2017. Almost out of gas you leave the freeway at the first exit and find your way to a local gas station but soon realize that gassing up and leaving the village will be more difficult that you thought....

425250.overview:
This is a classic snake game for your C64 home computer, but with a twist that makes it intentionally challenging (and no, this is not a joke). The game features a simple monochrome color scheme and the most basic graphics. Unlike the average snake game, this one is blazingly fast. Every point you score becomes a monumental struggle, and frustration will have you pulling your hair in no time. It's a game that ends before you even realize it began—a true test of endurance. Brace yourself for the most exasperating snake game you've ever encountered. To add insult to injury, the game includes a high-score table to meticulously track your woeful achievements.

But who needs another run-of-the-mill snake game for the C64? :)

The game supports 1 player, 2-player co-op, 2-player versus, 3-player co-op and 3-player versus game modes.

425251.overview:
Serpland is born from the development of the game Nibbler. It was created by Bertuccioli Manolo aka manolober. 
The movements are much more delimited, there is a temporal timer and puzzle elements have been inserted: sometimes it is not enough to collect all the fruits or stones to overcome the level.


It has 40 levels with a final congratulatory screen. In the plot of history the prince, after crossing the labyrinthine rooms of the castle of the damned, reaches the Zirtok stone that allows to put an end to evil.
For each game there are 3 lives but, in this version, I added 5 credits that can be used so as not to have to re-start every time from the end.

425254.overview: Released September 24, 2016 at the Mixed Game Competition at RetroKomp 2016 :  #6. This is the continuation of that game. In the game you choose your tribe: Polans, Pomeranians, Moravians or Drevlans, you can buy things , hunt, trade and go into battle. The game is made by Minimoog (code).

425272.overview:
Sokoban (倉庫番, Sōko-ban, lit. 'warehouse keeper') is a puzzle video game in which the player pushes boxes around in a warehouse, trying to get them to storage locations this PD version by Emanuele Feronato was released in 2022. The game is played on a board of squares, where each square is a floor or a wall. Some floor squares contain boxes, and some floor squares are marked as storage locations.

The player is confined to the board and may move horizontally or vertically onto empty squares (never through walls or boxes). To move a box, the player walks up to it and pushes it to the square beyond. Boxes cannot be pulled, and they cannot be pushed to squares with walls or other boxes. The number of boxes equals the number of storage locations. The puzzle is solved when all boxes are placed at storage locations.

425283.overview:
RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition 2015/2016, World of Commodore 2017, created by Michael Johnson and Richard Bayliss. Slime Deluxe is a fast paced arcade\shooter game based on the original Jim Summer's Commodore PET game.

Improvements were made to the original Slime C64 game released last month that include:
- Easier to play levels
- Custom music and graphics by Richard Bayliss
- Smart Bomb
- Extra Live at 10,000 points
- 8 way joystick control (over the original 4 way)
- Bug fixes
- Slower play mode with full frame animation (fast speed is double frame)
- Source code for parts of Slime Deluxe and full source code for the original Slime game

425381.overview:
Deep in the Caribbean lies Melee Island, ruled by the governor Elaine Marley. The cruel pirate LeChuck is deeply in love with her - so deeply that he refuses to accept his own death. As a ghost, he dwells with his undead crew somewhere near the mysterious Monkey Island. Meanwhile, a young fellow named Guybrush Threepwood is determined to become a real pirate. At the Scumm Bar, he meets three pirates who tell him he has to complete three difficult tasks in order to be worthy of this title. But as Guybrush is trying to complete these tasks, he encounters the lovely governor, and this meeting changes his life forever. Risking to incur the wrath of LeChuck, Guybrush has to prove his wit is as sharp as his sword, and figure out a way to foil the ghost pirate's plans. 
 
The puzzles are predominantly inventory-based; most of the problems in the game are solved by picking up items and combining them with each other or with objects (or people) in the game world. Several tasks are dialogue-based; among those is the humorous "insult swordfighting", which involves Guybrush learning and choosing witty insults while dueling pirates.

425388.overview: A Commodore 64 Dungeon Crawler created by Connor Milligan in 2023. Sorcery64 is something of a demake of sorcery, a project for my advanced programming class at the University of Vermont with Tim Harrold.

425391.overview:
If you've ever had any doubts about whether you can play Tetris using only C64 sprites, I'll put them to rest. SPRITEtris is a Commodore 64 game of mine which uses only sprites. I made it for the CSDB.dk Only Sprites Compo 2023.

Game controls:

    A - move left
    D - move right
    S - drop 1 line
    SPACE - hard drop
    , - rotate 90 degrees anticlockwise
    . - rotate 90 degrees clockwise

If you've just had a big meal, don't try this out; it's better to wait a couple of hours.

425394.overview: 8th in the C64 4kb Game Coding Competition 2020 4k game competition

425396.overview: Stranded Cats is a multiplayer (split-screen) adventure game for the Commodore 64

425413.overview: The aim of the game is to help Santa Claus recover all the gift packages stolen by the criminals.

425439.overview: Originally written for the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition by Alexander Paalvast and the rest at TWAiN PAiN Games in 2020, this is a single player action game that would be published by Reset64 Magazine.

425441.overview: the aim of the game is to survive as long as possible by jumping between lifts which get 'heated' by standing on them. heat for a few seconds, and a lift explodes, and when all lifts are gone, the game is over. it is also harmful to bounce off the ozone layer, bounce a few times too close and it's a game over too. so jump between lifts and then jump some more! after every minute, you'll progress to the next level, which will speed things up a bit and bring some more lifts. see if you can beat level 10!

425456.overview:
Synposis: You're playing two classic video games simultaneously! Break your blocks with your ball using your bat + navigate your snake and eat the dots!
Instructions: Use joystick in port 2. Control the bat using left or right direction. Control the snake using fire + any direction.
Missing a ball or crashing a snake into the grey border (or into itself) costs a life.
Eating a dot changes the border color to blue, which the snake can pass through.

425471.overview: This game, created for the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition. Fight is the second stickman adventure game from Megastyle. You are controlling two swordmen who are under constant attack from a ninja-star throwing warrior, and you have to knock away the stars. Controls are keyboard only, use F1 or F3 to hit.

425483.overview: Part of a series of stickman games, this particular one released as part of the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition, where you slide down the walls of a long tunnel and must avoid hazards found mostly on the sides of the wall you slide down. You can switch from side to side to avoid them and must try to go as deep as possible. Freudtastic! To make things more difficult you must control 2 sliders in different tunnels at the same time!

425496.overview:
SWYDS Game programmed by Jamie Fuller Music composed by Roy Widding. It placed 9th in the C64 4kb Game Coding Competition 2020 4k game competition. 

-"Do you still shower with your dad simulator is our c64 4k version of the steam cult classic from Marbenx. Use joystick port 2 and choose between 3 different kids, and make sure you don't run into the wrong dad shower. Watch our for slippery floor and soap"

425504.overview:
Overhead racing game for one or two players, created by Chris Page as part of the 2022 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition. Beat the competition in 5, 10 or 20-lap races of the track in cars with bald tyres.

For joystick only - plug into port 1 to drive the yellow car and port 2 to drive the blue car.

Hold fire to accelerate and release fire to brake. Move the joystick left or right to steer your car. Sprint to the finish and set a lap record; beat your friends or the latest in self-driving autopilot software.

425647.overview: Guide your little guy from platform to platform avoiding the falling faces while visiting the black platforms to bring color back to them.

425947.overview:
Sink is a game in which you play as a brush that has to clean up a sink while avoiding bugs. The game plays somewhat of a scaled down version of the arcade game, Bubbles.

The game's developer is currently unknown. It was published in Videoteca Computer #04 in 1984.

439835.overview:
Many years have passed since the evil wizard Kalen betrayed king Rizek.
 
Kalen fled the lands and for decades the king has tried to recover from his past, but those dark times are always with him. Memories of the beast remain, and the nightmares continue. 
 
Long before the reign of Rizek a great army of light invaded the lands to the north. The army had powerful weapons and smashed all that stood in its way. The most powerful weapon of all was the great ARMOUR OF GODS.  This endowed those who wore it the weapon of the sun and the ability to fly. 
 
All but two of the great weapons were rumoured to have been destroyed but now whispers have it that Kalen the wizard may have discovered the whereabouts of the armour.
 
If he manages to acquire the armour the reign of king Rizek will once more be under threat, a threat more dangerous than any before.
 
With revenge in his heart and the future of his lands at stake, the great king sets off on another adventure.

440203.overview:
Softporn Adventure is a comedic, adult-oriented adventure game and became the inspiration for the animated Leisure Suit Larry series. Actions are controlled through a verb and noun combination, typed into the game. Ultimately, you must win over the heart of various ladies in creative ways so as to get laid. The player is unnamed but the plot of the game is very similar to Leisure Suit Larry in the Land of the Lounge Lizards.

This is an unofficial port of the original version to the Commodore 64 developed and released into the public domain in 2013

443116.overview:
Spediteur is a board game like, turn based business simulation.
Become the most successful freight forwarder by earning the most money within a certain period of time. You need to transport goods between cities, so smart route planning will maximize your profits!
Traffic jams and sabotage can make your business difficult and sometimes you have to choose wisley whether it is worth switching  from the road to transport by ship or plane.

444309.overview: It's still winter. Have fun playing this snowball game with two. Use the joysticks to move, jump, duck and adjust the force to throw snowballs

444313.overview: This is a vertically scrolling C64 shoot'em up that has you piloting a space ship and making your way through levels, dealing with guardians, and generally trying to stay alive!

444317.overview: This is a racing game for the Commodore 64.  It is a simple arcade style racer, inspired by games like Pitstop and Pitstop 2.

444338.overview: Spinning Image is a game where you gradually build up the image on the playfield to match the solution on the right of the screen. Blocks must be placed onto the board as well as being removed to help build up to completion.

446534.overview:
Despite the game's name, Shoot a Skeet is not a legit sports based skeet shooting game in the traditional sense, rather it's a crosshair shooter masquerading as a skeet shooting game. The game was developed by Rolosoft and published in Commodore Info 1989/#06.

Attempt to shoot as many skeets as possible with the joystick plugged into port 2. You have a maximum of 25 skeets to try and shoot.

447025.overview:
The SEUDS team explode back onto the C64 with their most ambitious release to date! The fourth SEUDS compilation takes shoot 'em ups to the next level with massive controllable players, superb use of hi-res graphics, clever gameplay mechanics, awesome sonics, eye-popping presentation and MORE destruction than ever before!


includes "Tau Zero Reloaded", "Big Gun No.1", "Edge of Time - Double or Nothing 2", "Expendable Army" & "Gigablast"

447034.overview: Depths of Zimroel (called The Sword of Zimroel in the game's instruction manual) is a text based RPG for the Commodore 64. It was developed and published in 1983 as a mail order game by Crystal Microsoft Ltd., a company based in Houston, Texas.

447623.overview: Step into the monochromatic and mind-bending universe of Shift, where black and white landscapes hide more than meets the eye...where inside is outside, and light and dark don't differ!

447930.overview: Sky Saviour is an original shmup for the Commodore 64 written in in 6502 assembly.

447946.overview: A game by Jeremy Hammett from the book "Best of PCW Software for the Commodore 64", published in 1984. Can you save the 20 survivors of a marine disaster from certain death by drowning? You are the pilot of a Search and Rescue helicopter with the daunting task of finding and saving the survivors from the wrecked ship Commodore. You must do this by maneuvering your helicopter to a point above the boats, and then dropping a rope for the survivor to climb up. Once aboard fly back to shore and drop him off.

448244.overview:
To become a master you must enter the Dragon Temple and defeat various fighters spread over nine levels. You enter as a red belt and your ultimate goal as well as defeating all the fighters is to become a 5th Dan black belt.

The game is a beat-em-up and viewed from the side with the screen scrolling when you move. You must fight each fighter one at a time and must defeat them to move to the next one. You have various moves at your disposal by pressing the fire button and holding the joystick in various directions. Moves include high kick, punch and leg sweep. You can also produce a bamboo stick to help you in your mission.

You and your opponent have various bars and these represent various parts of the body and decreases when hit. If one reaches zero then either your opponent has been defeated or you lose one of nine lives. When you move up to a new level you receive nine more lives. One unique feature about the game is if you leave the joystick alone the computer plays for you until you press the fire button.

448315.overview: Square Out is a sliding tile puzzle game for the Commodore 64. The game was developed by Cosmos Designs and released in 64'er 1991/10.

448727.overview: C64 conversion of a 1987 Spectrum text adventure game with graphics. This new one is in both Italian and English.

448916.overview:
A compilation of the first 2 Spy vs Spy games released for the Commodore 64.

The Apple II and C64 versions were sold in the same box as a "flippy" release.

448921.overview: Silly Life is a very old school style platformer in which you need to find 10 pieces of a toy train while avoiding the various monsters. The train pieces are the flashing objects in 10 of the 16 rooms of the game. If you run low on energy, you need to visit The Room of Life (the room with the big "LIFE" text) in order to replenish your energy

448942.overview:
Two-player only shooter that also has a construction kit, it was created by Kevin Dixon and published by COMPUTE! Publications in COMPUTE!'s Gazette 1990/06 (Issue #84). 

In the year 2100, nuclear weapons are relics of a forgotten era. In this day and age, countries settle their differences in a duel between representative gladiators. The site of their engagement is the Arena, a man made battlefield consisting of treacherous pits and hills.

At the start of each duel, six lethal spheroid bombs are randomly scattered about the Arena. Each contestant moves about in a hovercraft, collecting the bombs and then firing them at the' opposing gladiator. Because of their spherical shape, the bombs roll across the Arena at high speeds. But at the same time, the undulating surface of the playfield makes their movement unpredictable. As you'll soon learn, the keys to survival in Spheroids arc quick reflexes and a deadly arm.

449149.overview:
Stack Up Basic is a public domain puzzle game coded entirely in BASIC for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Hungarian coder István "Steveboy" Maros, and released on December 17, 2016.

The game could be best described as a computerized version of Jenga.

451256.overview: Welcome to the sequel of THE CAMP, the super-duper text adventure! What the heck??? That adventure was difficult, in it's own texty way but was boring as hell? The action was missing? You would rather hit the shit? Then you are damn right here! Because this spin-off kicks in from the moment you filled your super t-soaker with peppermint tea... No more lazy word-clicking! Reach your anger, shake the stick and spray your brain away until the doc shows up! Free your kidnapped friends from the long fingers of the greasy aliens! Welcome to S.E.U.C.K. CAMP! A tribute to all SEUCK-, ADVENTURE- and CAMPING-FANS and to John Carpenter, Platoon, Impossible Mission, Ghost ´n Goblins, Giana Sisters and The Prodigy! (For instant fun you should hold THE CAMP (text adventure) disk at hand in the end...)

451302.overview: Spectrum is a 1984 solitaire card game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Donna K. Woody and published in Loadstar #4.

451495.overview:
A conversion of Derek Yu's classic roguelike platformer for the C64 (done with permission from Yu himself) Developed and published by PaulKo64 on September 1, 2024

Spelunky is a cave exploration / treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games and roguelikes, where the goal is to grab as much treasure from the cave as possible. Every time you play the cave's layout will be different. Use your wits, your reflexes, and the items available to you to survive and go ever deeper! Perhaps at the end you may find what you're looking for...

Paul Koller brings you the official Commodore 64 port of Spelunky. You can now play the classic roguelike how it would be intended on the best-selling 8bit computer!

System requirements
The file fits within 64Kb, and runs on both PAL (recommended) & NTSC C64 models. Play it in your favorite emulator, or transfer the file and play it on your original breadbin.

Controls
The game is fully joystick controlled from port 2:

Directions:

Walk, jump, climb, crawl
Run (when double left or right tap)
Look down (when holding joystick down for a second)

Tap button:
Whip (when no item carried)
Activate item in hand (when possible)
Throw item in hand
Drop / pick up / buy item (when also joystick down)
Hold button (for a second):
Take out / put back bomb (when joystick centered)
Throw rope (when also joystick up)

The game is currently $2.99 USD (or more) on the game's itch.io page

451602.overview: A cute shoot'em up also known as a Cute-em-up game with less-than-cute bosses and made with the SEUCK by the prolific Richard Bayliss. Also part of the TND Classix #05 compilation disk.

451604.overview: SWINTH is a music visualization game, inhabiting the realm where a SpiroGraph, amazing music and your imagination meet. The game came on a 5.25" floppy disk and it included 10 songs for SWINTH and the visualzation graphics for it. The visualization was a number of randomly moving lines that changed colors periodically. This could be changed by pressing one of 17 keys: V(vertical), H(horizontal), I(changes MAX increment), E(toggles MIN increment), F1,3 and 5 changes the color but F7 toggles random colors, and numbers 0-9 changes length of tail. The RUN/STOP key terminates SWINTH while SPACE plays the next song. SWINTH is considered a classic and is favored today by many.

451961.overview:
A 1-player only public domain German language text-based strategy game for the Commodore 64. It is an unofficial conversion of a Triumph Adler Alphatronic PC game. The developer(s) is unknown as of yet.

An unofficial English language translation was recently released.

452217.overview:
Sherlock Holmes is at it again! Now a book...

SHERLOCK HOLMES AND THE SECRET WEAPON: Interactive Visual Novel: Walter, Gabriel: 9798850790042: Amazon.com: Books 
and a game!!!

Making a movie/game "Charade" for c64 was fun, this time around its Mr. Holmes I presume. Get this visual novel based on AND THE SECRET WEAPON storyline! All for the c64!!! Coming soon in book form as well!! Enjoy.

452226.overview: A sadly unfinished game from Johan Forslöf and Paul Helman with sound by Cadaver. It has sprites and graphics that look so spooky and good that many have wondered if it was on a C64 or an Amiga. The demo features a main character reminiscent of Braid, with a hi-res overlay that looks impressive and animates smoothly. Although the backgrounds give the impression of being done in extended background mode, they are actually standard multi-colour hi-res (Johan has plans to implement ECM later). The atmosphere is wonderfully immersive, with a few enemies to shoot along the way. At this stage, there isn't much to do beyond exploring the multi-directional scrolling areas of the castle environment, but the demo offers a promising glimpse of what could evolve into an outstanding game.

453285.overview:
RetroGL is aiming on bringing Super Street Fighter II Turbo over to the Commodore 64 using his RetroFighter engine. An engine that was also used in the more recent homebrew C64 hit of SNK vs CAPCOM. The leader of the Shadaloo organization, M. Bison, in his global domination plan sets up a world fighting tournament, to select the best fighters to work in his Shadaloo organization through brainwashing.

Changes:

    enhanced appearance for all fighters (even if something has to be enhanced yet)
    endings for each fighter
    almost all fighting dynamics implemented (for example, throw escapes)

The next demo will have 2 bonus rounds and new backdrops and musics during the game.

453674.overview: Shove It is a sliding tile puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released in 1990 by Dave Johannsen as part of Loadstar #77,

454187.overview:
Shuriken is a collect em up game released on several systems, including the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Fabrizio Caruso (Cross Chase, Cross Snake, etc.) and was released into the public domain in 2023.

454467.overview: Santa’s Workout 4 is a puzzle game with two objectives in each level: rescue Santa and save a certain number of elves. Navigate and build paths through various exciting and colorful puzzles.

454473.overview: Soiled Iron is a classic two-opponent sword fighting game with some similarities to the Barbarian games. It offers a quest mode and a one-on-one fighting experience.

454942.overview: You control a star fighter and must destroy all the enemies and objects in your way to achieve ultimate victory!

455557.overview: This project is a study of Peter Finzel’s superb two-player head-to-head jump and run dungeon explorer for the Atari line of 8-bit home computers and my attempt to accurately port it to the Commodore 64.

455762.overview: Despite its name, Snazzy Snakes is not so much a snakes game, but a two player only Tron Light Cycles game. It was developed by Cyber Systems and published in Commodore Scene #18.

455892.overview: Safe Zone is an Arabic-style board game that is somewhere between Halma and a sliding puzzle. You play against a computer opponent who is quite good at the game.

456472.overview: Super Mole is a 1-player 1995 logical brain/puzzle game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Steve Emsley and published in Loadstar #131.

456483.overview: Super Real Darwin is a 1-2 player co-op shooter for the C64. It was developed by The Criminal Empire using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit and released into the public domain sometime in 1988.

456625.overview: Star Sweeper is a Minesweeper clone for the C64. It was developed by John Serafino and published in Loadstar #134.

456660.overview: Star Slots is a fruit/slot machine gambling game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by William Laabs, and released in 1995 as part of Loadstar #131.

456745.overview:
A multigenre game consisting of a vertically scrolling shmup, and an Arkanoid/Breakout variant.

It was developed by Newmonix Soft and published in Digital Dynamite's"GEMS" game pack.

A demo version was also released in Commodore Disk User 1988/09-10, although the demo version was released without the consent of the devs.

456830.overview:
Shootout at Fort Apache is a single-layer Wild West themed crosshair shooter for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Robert Mundschau and published in the following:

- Loadstar #130
- Scene World #06

456921.overview:
An unofficial C64 conversion of Roger Merritt's VIC-20 game of the same name

It was developed by Jörg Karwath and released on his Github repository in 2025.

457027.overview: This game is a C64 conversion of Space Invaders, the famous arcade game created by Tomohiro Nishikado in 1978.

457177.overview:
Star Chase is a 1983 pseudo 3D space shooter for the Commodore 64.

It was developed and published by Owen Grossman in 1983.

The game was a mail order commercial release.

457178.overview: Star Dijits is a 1999 puzzle board game for up to 2 players. It was developed by Ken Robinson and published in Loadstar #180.

457365.overview: Sprite Breakout is a new game for the Commodore C64, developed by Kevin Krausnick. Inspired by Breakout, it takes the place of a sprite twice the size. The goal is to remove all the bricks to advance to the next level and achieve the highest possible score.

457381.overview: You are the commander of a crew of eight astronauts on their journey to Mars. The mission goal is to establish a bridgehead for further colonization and performing scientific experiments.

457435.overview:
2025 SEUCK Compo Entry #13 and overall winner of the competition.

That pesky Nitwup Empire is at it again, trying to take over the Earth. (What's their problem?)
The Federation's active top pilots are busy elsewhere; Captain Ishtar is off to some backwater world called "Petit-4." So it's up to the semi-retired Cole Skimmer, decorated Star Captain, to stop the invasion force.
Speed away to the Asteroid Belt, where the Nitwups have established  a beachhead, and put an end to their plans. Oh, and the Nitwups have trapped several of our astronauts - try and pick up as many of them as you can.
Godspeed, Captain Skimmer!.

PLAYING THE GAME:

This is a 1 player game. Press Fire on the joystick to start the game.

The player controls a forward-firing ship.

A bonus life is gained for every 10,000 points scored.


HINTS & TIPS
------------
- Pick up trapped astronauts to gain vital bonus points.
- You are flying VERY close to the asteroids, so don't bump into cliffs and enemy structures.
- The enemies take careful aim! Keep on the move.
- When you encounter a boss ship, press UP to fly past it. (But you'd better take out its guns first!)

457521.overview:
This game is a C64 conversion of Space Invaders, the famous arcade game created by Tomohiro Nishikado in 1978.
This particular version is designed to be controlled exclusively via the joystick's fire button.

457628.overview:
S'words is a 1-4 player board/puzzle game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Arthur Moore and published by Softdisk Publishing in Loadstar #124.

457780.overview: Space Fight! is a 2v2 4 player game for the Commodore 64 using the Protovision adapter

457912.overview: This is a game whose logic is inspired by the well-known Simon color game. Repeat the color sequences until you complete the rainbows.  At each level the rainbow becomes bigger.

457944.overview: Hello everyone, my name is Shoriontea and I present to you STAR HERO. This is my first game, a shot'em up created with the basic S.E.U.C.K

458097.overview:
Shooting Stars is 1990 Compilation pack for the Commodore 64. It was published by Kingsoft, and was exclusively released in Germany.

Titles in this compilation:

- Grandmaster 
- Gotcha!
-:Bit Exorcist
- Julius Cäsar
- Karting Grand Prix
- Orion (Kingsoft)

458368.overview:
Spelling Demons is an educational spelling game for the Commodore 64. In the game you are given several choices for the correct spelling of the given word, and you must guess which one is correct.

The game was developed by Roger Norton and published in Loadstar #074 in 1990.

458698.overview:
Taito released the original Space Invaders arcade game in 1978, and as a high school student Satoshi Matsuoka created a masterpiece replica of Space Invaders for the Commodore PET in 1980.

Taito updated the original arcade game in 1979 with the release of Space Invaders Part II. The updated game featured more aliens, spawning aliens and different UFOs. 

This is an updated version of Professor Matsuoka's original PET game that more closely matches the gameplay of Taito's 1979 updated Part II version. Originally for the PET/CBM Series of computers, and now available on C64 with this port by Milasoft.

459522.overview: SCONNEX is a version of the famous 4-in-a-line game, written to work on almost any computer.

459596.overview: Slamball (not to the confused with the game from Synapse Software) is a pinball game for the C64. It was developed by George Parker and published in Loadstar #042 in 1987.

459598.overview: Sea Hawks is a pinball game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Dave Costello and released in PCS Club Disk #23.

460030.overview:
Color Scoit, or just simply Scoit, is a brain/puzzle game for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Paravision Company and published in Compute mit 1988/04.

460376.overview:
Svellas is a 2025 retro-style homebrew game by Inufuto, designed for a wide range of classic 8-bit systems like the MSX, ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64, and others.

Game Description:

Svellas is a fast-paced arcade maze/action game built in the minimalist, highly addictive style that Inufuto is known for.

Players navigate maze-like stages, focusing on quick reflexes and tight movement while avoiding dangers and completing objectives. Like many of Inufuto’s games, it emphasizes:

Simple, easy-to-learn mechanics

Score-chasing gameplay

Short, replayable sessions

Increasing difficulty and tension

The design leans heavily into classic arcade philosophy—pick up and play, survive as long as possible, and improve your performance with each run.

Gameplay Style:

Single-player experience

Controlled via keyboard or joystick

Combines action and puzzle-like movement within maze layouts

Built for instant accessibility but long-term mastery

460868.overview: A German language PD game for the Commodore 64, based on the popular animated adult TV show of the same name. The game was developed and published by B-Soft in 1999, as well as released by Tiger-Crew-Disk PD.

461321.overview: The player's task is to catch falling raindrops from a rain cloud while avoiding being struck by lightning. Each uncaught drop increases the water level, and if too many fall, the town will be flooded and our hero will lose his life. With each subsequent level, the difficulty increases in terms of the speed and number of falling drops and lightning bolts.

461346.overview: Shakesperian Quiz (also known as Shakespeare Quiz) is a simple educational quiz game that tests the player's knowledge on the writings of William Shakespeare. The game was developed by Armand Aiello and Ray White and published by Commodore Educational Software (a division of Commodore Business Machines that was based in Canada). The year of release is unkown.

461614.overview: The objective of the game is to collect as many coins as possible to avoid going bankrupt.

461809.overview: The Stronger Edition includes a total of 32 fighters and it's distributed as a MagicDesk 2 (MD2) CRT image file (2MBytes).  It can be run on VICE/Denise emulators and real hardware.

462065.overview:
Stealth Bomber: An Explosive Challenge is a 1-player strategical war game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Bob Blackmer and published in the following:

- Loadstar #091
- Game Star #1

462102.overview: A French language shoot em up game for 1-2 players (co-op) developed by DXCH using Chris Yates' Shoot 'Em Up Construction KIT, and released into the public domain in 1989.

462103.overview: microgame for ACMI's Game Worlds exhibition

462226.overview: Space Crystals is a simple little game for the beloved C64. Collect the rare Space Slug (TM) energy drinks to sell them for space crystals. Get rich fast!

462232.overview:
Scotland, 1962...
During an unscheduled tea break, the guards at Fharthmoor Prison allow semi-notorious cat burglar Snatch McBlagger to escape. And so McBlagger begins an epic crime spree that would have made a smashing film...

462402.overview: An arcade style game published in Computronic 1987/11-12 / a.k.a. "Jaceman".
